name: dsh-huggingface
description: The Hugging Face Hub as a surface the agent can interrogate before it downloads: five `hf_*` tools that reconcile the Hub's own file tree against the cache on THIS disk - what a repo weighs, which files a consumer would fetch, whether it is gated, whether it is already cached and at which revision - with byte-exact local sizes the CLI's JSON does not give, a cache that distinguishes 'cached' from 'complete', and a download that names its size and needs the repo id repeated back. Host-only: zero npm dependencies, no bundled engine, nothing fetched without `confirm`.
